problems.title: Analyze and graph a radical function
problems.question: Investigate and graph f(x)=x√[x/(x−1)].
problems.idea: Apply the formulas below and keep track of domains and exceptional cases.
steps: The graph passes through(0,0),has vertical asymptote x=1 and slant asymptote y=x+1/2 at both infinities.
It increases on(−∞,0],decreases on(1,3/2],then increases on[3/2,∞). Its right-branch minimum is(3/2,3√3/2).
Its second derivative is3/[4√(x/(x−1))(x−1)³],negative on x<0 and positive on x>1.
Range:(−∞,0]∪[3√3/2,∞). At0,the left derivative is0; the function is not defined immediately to its right.
problems.answer: The graph and all branch properties are described above.

problems.title: An ellipse focus on an equilateral triangle side
problems.question: An equilateral triangle is inscribed in an ellipse and its two foci lie on two triangle sides. In what ratio does a focus divide such a side?
problems.idea: Apply the formulas below and keep track of domains and exceptional cases.
formulas: Let the shared vertex be A,side length L,and AF₁=u,AF₂=v. The ellipse distance sum at A is u+v.
steps: At B,C,this gives BF₂=2u+v−L and CF₁=u+2v−L. The triangle inequality BF₂≥L−v implies u+v≥L.
Using the cosine rule with60° at A for both distances and subtracting yields(u−v)[4(u+v)−3L]=0. The second factor is positive,so u=v=tL.
Now BF₂/L=3t−1 and its square is1+t²−t. Equating gives8t²−5t=0,so t=5/8.
problems.answer: AF:FB=5:3, from the common vertex of the two focus-containing sides.

problems.question: An ant goes from A=(6,4) to B=(20,0),at3 m/min off the axes and6 m/min on them. Find the least time.
problems.idea: Apply the formulas below and keep track of domains and exceptional cases.
formulas: Enter the x-axis at(t,0),then follow it to B. Time=√[(t−6)²+16]/3+(20−t)/6 for t≤20.
steps: The off-axis distance is8/√3. Substitution gives total7/3+2√3/3.
A detour via the y-axis and origin is longer: even the direct A-to-y-axis segment takes at least2 minutes,and the remaining axis trip to B exceeds10/3 minutes.
